title: Split TaskDomainService into contract, storage, and orchestration layers
description:
Problem: TaskDomainService currently mixes models/contracts, validation, persistence, and activity-history concerns in one service.

Desired outcome: clearer boundaries and lower complexity for task-domain evolution.

Scope:
- In scope: separate contracts/models, file persistence adapter, and orchestration/validation service.
- Out of scope: task feature additions.

Acceptance criteria:
- Core task-domain concerns are separated into focused units.
- API behavior remains compatible.
- Activity logging behavior remains unchanged.

Validation:
- Run tasks API and task-page tests.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created from F-004 as Sprint 2 committed decomposition work.
